name: BLAKEKit
description: Browser-based BLAKE hash calculator supporting BLAKE2b-256, BLAKE2b-512, BLAKE2s-128, BLAKE2s-256, BLAKE3-256, and BLAKE3-512. All computation is local — no data is transmitted.
headline: BLAKE3 Hash Calculator
featureList: Text hashing, File hashing, Hex output, Base64 output, Binary output, Hash history, Random hash generation
